description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldMultiEnum class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldEnum to handle multi-select enumeration fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It provides methods for constructing SQL queries to filter records based on multi-enum field values, including filtering for 'not in', 'in', 'is', and 'is not' conditions, and handles encoding custom fields appropriately.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldMultiEnum
classes.description: A class for handling multi-enumeration fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, providing methods for constructing SQL filter queries for such fields.

methods.name: queryFilternot_one_of
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query fragment to filter records where the multi-enum field does not contain any of the specified values.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query fragment to filter records where the multi-enum field contains any of the specified values.

methods.name: queryFilteris
methods.description: Generates an SQL condition to match a multi-enum field for a specific value, encoding custom fields as needed.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not
methods.description: Generates an SQL condition to exclude a specific value from a multi-enum field, encoding custom fields as needed.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Provides an ORDER BY clause for multi-select fields, treating the stored string as a normal field.

methods.name: encodeMultienumCustom
methods.description: Detects if a multi-enum field is custom, and encodes its value with carets (^) for proper filtering.
